item.title: $7,000 bail granted for possessing unlicensed firearm
item.description: A MAN accused of walking with a gun on Murray Street was granted bail on Friday.

item.title: Dementia patient goes missing from hospital
item.description: A FAMILY has accused the Princess Margaret Hospital (PMH) of negligence after their elderly father, a dementia patient, went missing after being admitted on Saturday, with relatives saying they were not informed of his disappearance until the following day.

item.title: Bahamians stuck in Dubai as PM warns of economic impact from Iran conflict
item.description: EXPLOSIONS echoed across Dubai on Saturday as intercepted missiles lit up the night sky, sending some Bahamians scrambling back to their hotels while waiting for a way home after the United States and Israel waged war on Iran.

item.title: Roberts Roberts healing in healing in hospital
item.description: Super Value owner Rupert Roberts has reassured customers of his 13-store grocery chain and the Bahamian public: “I’m really on the road to recovery.”

item.title: First aviation ambulance in Mayaguana under deal between govt, BACSWN and Response Plus Medical (RPM)
item.description: AN aviation-spec ambulance has been deployed to the newly commissioned Mayaguana International Airport, in keeping with the terms of a Heads of Agreement between the Government of The Bahamas, Bahamas Aviation Climate and Severe Weather Network (BACSWN) and Response Plus Medical (RPM).

item.title: PM opens $2.1m Mayaguana airport tied to 2,000-job seaport project
item.description: The Prime Minister has declared that Mayaguana’s economy will be “forever changed” as he commissioned the island’s new $2.1m airport terminal, tying the upgrade to a planned three-phase deepwater seaport projected to generate 2,000 jobs.

item.title: Former Grand Lucayan employees collect final severance payouts
item.description: FORMER employees of the Grand Lucayan Resort began collecting severance cheques on Friday, with some saying the payouts were lower than they had anticipated after years of working on short-term contracts.

item.title: Sebas Bastian’s new memoir achieves US bestseller status
item.description: SEBAS Bastian has launched a memoir that his team says has earned bestseller recognition in the United States.

item.title: ‘Alarming’ 26 child sex cases logged at Bahamas Crisis Centre
item.description: THE Bahamas Crisis Centre received 26 sexual cases involving children aged eight to 16 in January and February, a figure its administrator described as alarming.
